recommendation_summary: Have cron run a small wrapper around the Python script that emails the user with FAILED in the subject whenever the script exits non-zero, using the mail path that already sends the summary, and renew the expired token.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when nightly-sync dies without reading logs. You proposed a central log on the Synology, Pieter Levels style, maybe all of it in Docker.
labels.Deleted: Central log, Docker, and relocating the job onto the Synology. A log does not notify you, and you won't read one. The outage was a startup crash on edna before the email step.
labels.Bottleneck: The only notice is sent by the Python process that already died, so a failed start stays silent.
labels.Checked myself: Only your description. I have not inspected edna, cron, or the NAS.

note: The reply recommends one failure-alert wrapper and says plainly that it won't alert if edna is down; renewing the token is a fix to the job, not a second monitoring mechanism.
